game_updates.contents: Major Update 0.7 is Here!Hello backrooms explorers!After a few months of work, we are finally releasing Version 0.7, one of the biggest updates we have made so far.This update was originally planned to launch a few weeks ago, but we decided to take more time to improve the overall game experience and fix several bugs that were affecting gameplay. game_updates.contents: ・Randomization has been introduced for furniture and other elements in the "Hide-and-Seek Mansion" map. game_updates.title: Payday 2's next update is "a massive undertaking" to modernize the FPS, stop crashes, and cut its install size by 60%
game_updates.contents: It's been nine months since Starbreeze handed the Payday 2 reins over to Sidetrack Games to continue supporting it, while the original developer focused on improving Payday 3. So far, the numbers are very much in Sidetrack's favor, with Payday 2 still routinely pulling 30,000-player peaks on Steam as its successor struggles to stay at just 1,000. Rather than simply rest easy, however, the new team is preparing for its biggest overhaul yet, transporting the heist shooter across to a fresh engine that should result in smoother gameplay at a massively reduced file size. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Payday 2's next update is "a massive undertaking" to modernize the FPS, stop crashes, and cut its install size by 60%

game_updates.title: PAYDAY 2: Engine Upgrade Open-Beta Announcement
game_updates.contents: Hello Heisters!It is time to announce the next update coming for the game, and its quite a big one...This is a huge milestone for PAYDAY 2 and it has been a massive undertaking for our team.Some of the improvements are but not limited to:The long awaited port to 64 bitsAn upgrade from DX9 to DX11 renderingGame file size reduction to ~32gbFaster load times on SSDs6 character lobby codesAnd more...With any big change, there are bound to be some bugs, therefore we will have an open beta period running starting from June 30th until the end of July. This should give us time to iron out any potential quirks, and also for modders to get their mods updated. More information will be revealed about the beta test on the 30th.Welcome to the world of tomorrow!Sidetrack Games ː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ː

game_updates.title: Update 3.0.433. Sand Temple Treasures Event
game_updates.contents: This is a safe PvP event, also available on PvE servers. On death, you do not lose loot or durability. Even beginners can take part, and special event weapons can be purchased for silver.We have also added two event rooms to Shattered Castle, where you can receive similar rewards and complete most quests! The archaeologists of Iteria discovered the ruins of the Sand Temples and carried out excavations, but the expedition did not go as planned: the spirits of the guardians possessed the archaeologists, granting them ancient deadly weapons and filling them with bloodlust. The entire expedition destroyed one another, and sandstorms buried the discoveries. game_updates.title: Terraria 1.4.5.7 is finally giving my favorite weapon type the love it's deserved for years
game_updates.contents: There's not much you could have said to get me more excited for the next Terraria update than this. Re-Logic is currently working on a big round of balancing and additional weapon changes for the upcoming patch 1.4.5.7, with the goal of making every class feel worthwhile and fun to play. As part of that, it's finally taking a look at what is unquestionably the most fun offensive option in the sandbox indie game - yoyos. In a new Terraria State of the Game for June 2026, Head of Business Strategy Ted 'Loki' Murphy talks about yoyo upgrades, crossplay plans, and the largest hotfix in Terraria's history. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Terraria 1.4.5.7 is finally giving my favorite weapon type the love it's deserved for years
